what: Link between pet-owner inflation (HICP 09.3.4 pets / US pets CPI) and headline inflation, per study country
method: Calendar-year average index -> YoY inflation; OLS pet = alpha + beta*headline, 2000-2025; spread = mean(pet - headline) 2015-2025. Source: data/pet-hicp.json (FRED mirrors of Eurostat HICP + BLS CPI).
findings: Europe: relationship is real — correlations 0.5-0.9 (median ~0.74), beta mostly >= 1: pet inflation amplifies headline inflation.
United States: NO correlation (r = -0.08). US pet inflation is structural at ~4%/yr (alpha 4.4, beta ~0) regardless of headline CPI — anchor it on its own mean, not on CPI projections.
Measured 2024-25 pet inflation is already far below the model's flat forward gp: Poland 4.4%/3.5% vs 7% assumed; Germany 1.7%/0.6% vs 4.5% assumed. The 2021-24 burst is over.
projection_basis: gp_forward = alpha + beta x projected headline inflation 2026-28 (ECB/EC/IMF-style: euro area ~2%, PL ~3.2%, HU ~3.7%, RO ~4%, UK ~2.2%, US ~2.4%). UK/RO/CZ have no pet series -> proxied via euro-area/Poland relationships, labelled. TR/IL unchanged (USD-terms basis).
